resources.string: Choose a widget below and confirm with your launcher. If no confirmation appears, hold an empty area of the home screen and choose Widgets. On some OPPO, OnePlus or realme phones, leave search and scroll to the bottom of Cards to find Plugins, then look for Classy. Labels vary by system.

Request sent to the launcher. Complete the system confirmation, then check your home screen. This does not mean the widget has been added. If nothing happens, add it manually or copy diagnostics for feedback.
This launcher does not support adding widgets from the app. Please add it manually.
The launcher did not accept the request. Try adding manually and copy diagnostics for feedback.
The system recognizes all widgets. Check the launcher widget list or try adding above; registration does not guarantee launcher visibility.
Some widgets are not recognized by the system. Copy diagnostics for feedback; no need to uninstall or clear data.
Widget status is unavailable. Refresh later or copy diagnostics.
Copied device, launcher and widget information. Timetable content is not included.

Some classes are marked only as evening. Confirm their first and last periods; the default is 10–13. You can edit exact times in the import preview. All pages will be collected; do not change pages meanwhile.
